question: When was the Bharat Nirman Programme launched by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2005**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharat Nirman Programme** was launched in the year **2005**.
 
• The programme aims to build rural infrastructure and covers six key areas: **water supply, housing, roads, telecommunication, irrigation, and electrification**.
 
• It is a comprehensive plan to improve the quality of life in rural India and bridge the rural-urban divide.
 
• The programme is implemented by various ministries and departments of the Government of India, ensuring coordinated efforts for rural development.
 
• Bharat Nirman is an initiative to provide basic amenities and create opportunities for sustainable livelihoods in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Bharat Nirman Programme** was a time-bound plan for action in rural infrastructure by the Government of India in partnership with the State Governments and Panchayati Raj Institutions.
 
• The programme was a significant step towards achieving the goals of inclusive growth and rural development.
 
• It was launched during the tenure of Prime Minister **Dr. Manmohan Singh**.
 
• The programme has had a substantial impact on improving rural infrastructure and living standards in India.
 
• Effective implementation of the programme has been crucial in ensuring the holistic development of rural areas in the country.
